question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(3)
solution:
The correct answer is '**made**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the historical timeline of silk manufacturing.
 
• The verb used should indicate the completion or occurrence of the discovery event in history.
 
• "**Made**" fits well as it suggests the discovery was completed, which aligns with the context of historical events.
 
• Other options ("**Tailed**", "**Baked**", "**Coerced**") do not fit the context or meaning in relation to the discovery process.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tailed (पूंछा गया): **"Tailed" is unrelated to the context of making a discovery.
 
• **Baked (पकाया गया): **"Baked" refers to cooking and does not apply to the process of discovery.
 
• **Coerced (जबरदस्ती किया गया):** "Coerced" means forced and is irrelevant to the context of an historical discovery.
